extracted.intended_audience: Spanish-speaking left-wing readers, activists, and scholars interested in EU/US foreign policy and imperialism
extracted.subtask_description: A Spanish-language left-wing opinion/news analysis criticizing EU/NATO "humanitarian" interventions (Kosovo, Libya, CAR, etc.), documenting alleged abuses, corruption, and geopolitical motives behind interventions. The piece blends historical background, reportage, and polemic critique.
